description: INEGI Cuenta Satélite de la Cultura de México (CSCM) 2024 — headline PIB + empleo for the cultural sector. MXN 865,682 mi (2.8 % of total economy), 1.43 mi puestos (3.5 %), real growth +1.2 % vs total economy +1.3 %. Phase 5b of the corpus expansion — sibling to csc_comercio (the trade module already ingested).
notes: Reference year 2018 for real-value series. Atana corpus's first LATAM non-Brazilian PIB/empleo cell. See docs/methodology/inegi_csc.md §6 for the non-trade module update.
